standard_prerequisites.name: Hom-tensor adjunction with diagonal G-action: Hom_{Lambda[G]}(P tensor_A M, N) = Hom_{A[G]}(P, Hom_Lambda(M, N)) with the conjugate action (g.phi)(m) = g phi(g^{-1}m)
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces exactness of Hom_{Lambda[G]}(P tensor M, -) to the displayed composite.

core_obligations: For any Lambda[G]-module N, the adjunction with diagonal action identifies Hom_{Lambda[G]}(P tensor_A M, N) with Hom_{A[G]}(P, Hom_Lambda(M, N)), where the G-action on Hom_Lambda(M, N) is the conjugation (g phi)(m) = g phi(g^{-1} m) (proof lines 1704-1711). Since P is a projective A[G]-module, Hom_{A[G]}(P, -) is exact; since M is finite projective over Lambda, Hom_Lambda(M, -) is exact; and the functor N -> Hom_Lambda(M, N) with conjugate G-action is exact as a functor of G-modules because the underlying Lambda-linear maps are (proof lines 1711-1713). The composite is exact, so P tensor_A M is a projective Lambda[G]-module (proof lines 1703-1713).
proof_roadmap: Rewrite Hom out of the tensor product with diagonal action via the adjunction (proof lines 1704-1711).
Check exactness of the composite functor using projectivity of P and M (proof lines 1711-1713).
